Title: Activate Product Analytics
Description: Activate Product Analytics in Datadog UI https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/
Success Criteria: Product Analytics enabled and accessible in Datadog UI

Title: Create Charts (Templates)
Description: Turn user data into actionable insights (using pre-built templates) https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/charts/chart_basics/
Success Criteria: Charts created from templates with user data visible

Title: Pathways (Sankey Visualization)
Success Criteria: Pathway diagrams rendering user journey data

Title: Funnel Analysis
Description: Ability to create user journey funnel charts https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/charts/funnel_analysis
Success Criteria: Funnel charts displaying user journey conversion steps

Title: Retention Analysis
Description: Measures how often users are successfully returning to a page or action https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/charts/retention_analysis/
Success Criteria: Retention charts showing user return patterns

Title: Query Data in Analytics Explorer
Description: Explore aggregated data to understand how your product is being used https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/charts/analytics_explorer
Success Criteria: Aggregated product usage data queryable in Analytics Explorer

Title: Segments
Description: Segment based on user behaviour and/or user profile https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/segmentation/
Success Criteria: User segments created and applied to analytics

Title: [Future] Segment with External Data
Description: Segment based on External Data (Reference Table or CSV) https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/segmentation/#using-external-or-third-party-data
Success Criteria: External data source linked and segments filtering correctly

Title: User Profiles
Description: Data about users from RUM SDK https://docs.datadoghq.com/real_user_monitoring/application_monitoring/browser/advanced_configuration/?tab=npm#identify-user-session
Success Criteria: User profiles populated with RUM SDK data

Title: Enrich User Profiles with Custom Attributes
Description: Use custom attributes to enrich profiles https://docs.datadoghq.com/product_analytics/profiles/#user-profiles
Success Criteria: Custom attributes visible on user profiles
